skill.summary: Bridge between OpenClaw and VS Code Copilot — dispatch coding tasks from any OpenClaw channel to VS Code for execution.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Integrates OpenClaw with VS Code Copilot to execute coding tasks locally.

- Dispatch write, edit, review, or debug requests from OpenClaw directly to VS Code Copilot.
- Utilizes local HTTP endpoints for all communication; no data is sent externally.
- Includes setup instructions and workflow for task execution and result display.
- Requires VS Code to be open with Copilot in Agent mode for full functionality.
- Health check and endpoint details provided for troubleshooting.
